mapper.select: select c.*, COALESCE(u.user_name, c.commenter_name) as user_name, CASE WHEN c.commenter_avatar IS NOT NULL AND c.commenter_avatar != '' THEN c.commenter_avatar WHEN u.avatar IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(u.avatar AS CHAR) ELSE NULL END as avatar from fun_physics_moments_comment c left join ape_user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.moments_id = #{momentsId} order by c.create_time asc
